tools.name: HexStrike AI
tools.freeTier: Free MCP server (MIT)
tools.catch: Needs an MCP AI app and the security tools installed; some optional tools are paid; run in an isolated VM on systems you're authorized to test

tools.name: Activepieces
tools.freeTier: Free self-hosted (MIT core); free cloud plan with 1,000 credits/mo
tools.catch: SSO is on the paid Team plan; audit logs, Git sync and custom roles are on the enterprise plan

tools.name: ai-job-search
tools.freeTier: Free framework (MIT) you fork and run locally
tools.catch: Needs a paid Claude plan or API credits

tools.name: MyResumo
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (MIT)
tools.catch: Needs an AI API key (DeepSeek by default, or OpenAI) and a MongoDB database

tools.name: AiSOC
tools.freeTier: Open source and self-hostable (MIT); runs without an API key
tools.catch: Needs Docker Compose with 8 GB memory; the bundled local AI model is small, not a frontier model

tools.name: Nebula
tools.freeTier: Free desktop app (BSD-2)
tools.catch: Linux x86_64 preview installers only (DEB or AppImage); needs your own model (Ollama, vLLM, Claude, OpenRouter); voice incurs OpenAI charges

tools.name: career-ops
tools.freeTier: Free (MIT); runs inside an AI coding CLI on your machine
tools.catch: Free AI tiers (Gemini, OpenRouter) are rate limited; local Ollama needs suitable hardware and larger models for reliable results

tools.name: JobOps
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted; hosted cloud is paid
tools.catch: Includes anonymous usage analytics (opt out by blocking umami.dakheera47.com); Commons Clause: no selling or paid hosting

tools.name: Inbox Zero
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (AGPL)
tools.catch: Self-hosting needs your own Google OAuth app (Microsoft is optional); AI can run on Ollama (free) or your own key

tools.name: GrillKit
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Bring your own model: Ollama/vLLM locally or a cloud API key

tools.name: Postiz
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (AGPL); paid cloud with 7-day trial
tools.catch: Self-hosting means registering your own developer app on each social network; some, like Meta and TikTok, need app review

tools.name: PentestGPT
tools.freeTier: Free (MIT); run locally or in Docker
tools.catch: Main mode needs a Claude Code/Codex login; Ollama only in legacy mode

tools.name: JobSync
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (MIT)
tools.catch: Docker setup; AI uses Ollama by default, or your own cloud key

tools.name: paperless-gpt
tools.freeTier: Free and open source when self-hosted (MIT)
tools.catch: Needs an existing paperless-ngx install plus an OpenAI key or Ollama

tools.name: RAGFlow
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Recommends 4 CPU cores, 16 GB RAM and 50 GB disk; models can run locally with Ollama or vLLM, or use your own key

tools.name: Vane (ex-Perplexica)
tools.freeTier: Free and open source when self-hosted (MIT)
tools.catch: Needs your own AI API key or a local model via Ollama

tools.name: ResuLLMe
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (MIT); public demo available
tools.catch: Needs an OpenAI or Gemini key, or a self-hosted model such as Ollama (any OpenAI-compatible endpoint)

tools.name: Interview Coach
tools.freeTier: Free command-line tool with a local web dashboard
tools.catch: Use Ollama for offline use, or a cloud AI provider

tools.name: Jan
tools.freeTier: Free desktop app with offline local models
tools.catch: Needs 8 GB RAM minimum (16 GB recommended); cloud models need your own API key from that provider

tools.name: Shannon
tools.freeTier: Free CLI (AGPL); you pay only your own AI costs
tools.catch: Needs your source code and an AI key; black-box testing is paid Pro

tools.name: SOC Range
tools.freeTier: Free (MIT); runs locally with Node.js or Docker
tools.catch: Simulated data only; the optional AI Copilot needs local Ollama

tools.name: Langflow
tools.freeTier: Free & open source (MIT); you pay only for a cloud AI model you connect
tools.catch: Needs Python 3.10-3.14 and uv, or Docker. Local models need Ollama and enough memory. The Desktop app download asks for your email

tools.name: Dify
tools.freeTier: Free self-hosted Community Edition; free cloud Sandbox (200 credits)
tools.catch: License: no multi-workspace service without written permission from Dify, and the logo and copyright must stay

tools.name: Open Notebook
tools.freeTier: Free & open source (MIT); you pay only for a cloud AI if you use one
tools.catch: Needs Docker. No password by default: bind it to 127.0.0.1 or set one. Podcasts need a text-to-speech provider; Ollama has none

tools.name: LibreChat
tools.freeTier: Open source (MIT license); you host it yourself
tools.catch: Needs your own AI API keys, or a local model via Ollama

tools.name: JobSync-Service
tools.freeTier: Free code (MIT); you deploy it yourself
tools.catch: Needs an AI app that supports MCP (Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor); that app's plan limits apply

tools.name: PurpleLlama
tools.freeTier: Evals and CodeShield: MIT. Llama Guard, Prompt Guard: Llama Community licenses
tools.catch: Benchmarks test an LLM you supply, through a provider API key or a self-hosted model

tools.name: PyRIT
tools.freeTier: Free Python library (MIT)
tools.catch: You configure your own AI endpoints and keys

tools.name: AnythingLLM
tools.freeTier: Free desktop app or self-hosted Docker (MIT); paid hosted option
tools.catch: Multi-user and embed widget need the Docker version; local AI needs decent hardware

tools.name: Agentic Security
tools.freeTier: Free & open source (Apache 2.0); no SaaS, no account
tools.catch: Needs Python 3.15+. Scanning a paid API costs one call per prompt; test datasets download from Hugging Face

tools.name: n8n
tools.freeTier: Free self-hosted Community Edition (fair-code license)
tools.catch: SSO, Git version control and Projects are not in the free Community Edition; they need a paid Business or Enterprise plan

tools.name: DeepInterview
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Live voice needs LiveKit plus speech and AI keys, or a fully local setup

tools.name: NeMo Guardrails
tools.freeTier: Free Python library (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Collects anonymous usage telemetry (opt out with DO_NOT_TRACK=1); you choose and configure the LLM it guards

tools.name: garak
tools.freeTier: Free command-line scanner (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Needs a target model to test: a local Hugging Face model, or an API (OpenAI, Cohere, Groq and others) with your own key

tools.name: Ollama
tools.freeTier: Free & unlimited for local models (MIT); paid cloud optional
tools.catch: Local models run on your own hardware; cloud models are billed per token on pay as you go

tools.name: Open WebUI
tools.freeTier: Self-hosted; Open WebUI License with a branding clause
tools.catch: Has no models of its own: connect Ollama or an API. Removing branding needs permission or a license once users pass 50.

tools.name: promptfoo
tools.freeTier: Free CLI (MIT); red teaming capped at 10k probes/month
tools.catch: Red-team generation uses promptfoo's servers unless you set your own key or model

tools.name: ElevateLI
tools.freeTier: MIT-licensed Chrome extension, no account; AI use billed by your provider
tools.catch: Not on the Chrome Web Store (load unpacked); AI needs your own key or Ollama

tools.name: Reactive Resume
tools.freeTier: All resume features free at rxresu.me; MIT self-host too
tools.catch: AI writing help needs your own key or Ollama

tools.name: AI Job Hunter
tools.freeTier: Free and open source; runs offline with Ollama or uses your own API key
tools.catch: Large, fast-changing app; crash reports go to Sentry by default (can turn off)

tools.name: Abhyas
tools.freeTier: Free (MIT); runs in your browser, data stays on your device
tools.catch: Voice needs your own Gemini/OpenAI key; local models are text-only

tools.name: Resume Matcher
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: You pick the model: local Ollama, your coding agent, or your own cloud API key

tools.name: Tracecat
tools.freeTier: Free self-hosted (AGPL): 1 workspace, unlimited workflows
tools.catch: Free plan includes SSO and audit logs; REST API, Git sync, forms and metrics need the paid Team plan

tools.name: Strix
tools.freeTier: Free command-line tool (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Needs Docker plus an AI key or local model; authorized testing only

tools.name: Vigil
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted with Docker (Apache-2.0)
tools.catch: Runs several Docker services (PostgreSQL, Redis, Bifrost); AI needs your own provider key or local Ollama

tools.name: PentAGI
tools.freeTier: Free when self-hosted with Docker (MIT)
tools.catch: Needs an LLM (cloud key or local Ollama/vLLM); a EULA applies; only test systems you own or are authorized to assess

tools.name: Meetily
tools.freeTier: Free desktop app (MIT Community Edition); paid PRO separate
tools.catch: Speaker identification, integrations and advanced exports are in paid PRO; Ollama is the recommended local option for summaries
